title: fix: say a new model needs a minute where it is created
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Agent and community-model dialogs now explain that saved changes can take a minute or two to become callable. Polli CLI 0.1.52 adds the same notice after `my-models create`, `my-models update`, and `agents update`; the `/account/agents` and `/account/my-models` docs also explain the delay. This adds guidance, not a change to model lookup or call behavior.
